content: चित् €1 <ab>P.</ab> €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (चेतति, चेतयते, चेतित) .²1 To perceive, see, notice, observe; नेषूनचेतन्नस्यन्तम् <ls>Bk. 17. 16</ls>; चिचेत रामस्तत्कृच्छ्रम् <ls n="Bk.">14. 62</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 38</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">2. 29</ls>. .²2 To know, understand, be aware or conscious of; परैरध्यारुह्यमाणमात्मनं न चेतयते <ls>Dk. 154</ls>; कादम्बरीरसभरेण समस्त एव मत्तो न किंचिदपि चेतयते जनोऽयम् <ls>K. 240</ls>. .²3 To regain consciousness. .²4 To aim at, intend, design (with <ab>dat.</ab>). .²5 To desire or long for. .²6 To be anxious about, care for, be intent upon, be engaged in. .²7 To resolve upon. .²8 To appear, shine. .²9 To be regarded as. .²10 To make attentive, remind of. .²11 To teach, instruct. .²12 To form an idea, be conscious of, understand, comprehend think, reflect upon. .²13 To be awake; जगत्येकः स चेतति <ls>L. D. B.</ls>

चित् {%f.%} [चित्-संपदा˚ भावे क्विप्] .²1 Thought, preception. .²2 Intelligence, intellect, understanding; <ls>Bh. 2. 1</ls>, <ls n="Bh.">3. 1</ls>. .²3 The heart, mind; मुक्ताफलैश्चिदुल्लासैः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 11. 33</ls>. .²4 The soul, spirit, the animating principle of life. .²5 Brahman.
